reviews.text: Café Gopala, Malleshwaram is a small, cozy place that serves Jain food. I really liked the simple, welcoming vibe of this little café. I tried the gobi noodles and blue curacao juice. The noodles tasted good and were a bit different from the usual, though they were slightly bland for my preference, as I enjoy stronger flavors in noodles. The juice was very refreshing and balanced well with the meal. I would definitely visit again, as I have heard good reviews about their other dishes and would like to try more from the menu.
reviews.author: Mithun

reviews.text: Delicious Food prepared with lots of love and care. Kudhoss to Chef Gopala. Feel like eating more and more. We would like to come again and again.
reviews.author: Kiran Jogi

reviews.text: After having visited twice in 2 days, I like the place. Tried the masala puri, aloo puri on day 1 and and went for dinner the 2nd day. The dine in location is a cozy old house which is made a make shift restaurant. Few items on the menu are either not available or not made (reason: limited staff). Ordered vada pav, aloo Paratha, Chinese Bhel, golden fried baby corn, vegetable pulao and pineapple juice. All these were good, with the baby corn being average. Overall a good place, the owners are pleasant and friendly people. Some staff members do not speak kannada yet but are trying which is good. I guess that's the norm these days anywhere in Bengaluru. Full marks for the effort of all involved, great pricing for the portion sizes and personally a pretty convenient location!
reviews.author: Abhishek MK

reviews.text:
A beautifully crafted outlet by devoted hands, offering a delightful experience for anyone seeking pure satvik vegetarian cuisine (prepared without onion, garlic, artificial colors, or taste enhancers). The food was incredibly tasty, hygienic, and served in generous portions.

Their extensive menu caters to all cravings, featuring North Indian, South Indian, soups, pasta, Chinese, chaat, and more.
Highly recommended for a wholesome dining experience!
reviews.author: Likith Kumar
